statistic: From all40 certified positive-degree LPs plus degreezero witness, kappa_d=F(d+1)+F(d-1)-2F(d) for d1..39, using exact doubled objectives. R=max(kappa)/sum(kappa). If allkappa=0 defineR=0/1. Compare realR>nullR by exact integer crossproducts; strict ties fail. No arbitrary peak threshold or graphtruth used in statistic.
